definitions.explanation: The order of mammals that includes humans, apes, monkeys, and prosimians (such as lemurs). The Japanese term literally means 'chief of spirits/souls class,' reflecting the traditional view of primates as the most intelligent animals.

notes:
Japan has a strong tradition of primate research, with Kyoto University's {霊長類|れいちょうるい}⟦{研究所|けんきゅうじょ}→研究所：19075_kenkyuujo⟧ being a world-leading institution. {霊長|れいちょう} literally means "chief of spirits" — the idea that primates are the most exalted animals.
